thread:
alex m: heads up, ran into a weird redwoodctl state when switching profiles. did `redwoodctl login --profile staging` then `redwoodctl whoami` and it errored:

error: failed to read config: missing active_profile

samir: what platform/version?

alex m: MacBook Air M1, macOS 13.5. `redwoodctl version` -> `redwoodctl v0.9.1 (darwin-arm64)`

alex m: sanitized config dump:

$ cat ~/.redwood/config.json
{
  "profiles": { "default": {"token":"***"}, "staging": {"token":"***"} }
  // note: no active_profile key present
}

jessica: ah, that's the older schema. v0.9.2 added an explicit `active_profile` field. CLI v0.9.1 won't set it. quick fixes: set env `REDWOOD_PROFILE=staging` or run the migration helper.

alex m: migrate helper? where is that documented?

jessica: `redwoodctl migrate-config --from v0.9.1` — it will insert `"active_profile": "staging"` and normalize perms. you can also manually edit the file.

alex m: tried migrate and got `open ~/.redwood/config.json: permission denied` — i think i installed brew/cli under sudo earlier so dotfiles are root-owned :grimacing:

samir: yep. run `sudo chown -R $(whoami) ~/.redwood` then rerun migrate. also double-check Homebrew prefix on M1 (`/opt/homebrew`) vs Intel (`/usr/local`) because some folks end up with config in another user path.

alex m: chown fixed it, migrate succeeded, `redwoodctl whoami` now shows my email. thanks.

devops-bot: FYI tokens from `redwoodctl login` default to 12h expiry. Use `redwoodctl login --refresh` or enable `session_auto_refresh` in Console.

alex m: extra thing — when i run `redwoodctl local serve --profile staging` sometimes it picks up a cached token and then i see 401. any local workaround?

samir: `redwoodctl login --profile staging --force` forces interactive reauth and replaces the cached token. for noninteractive CI use `REDWOOD_TOKEN` or service account credentials.

alex m: `--force` worked. opened a tiny PR to auto-detect missing active_profile and add it with a test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/pull/678

marco: nice. i filed an issue suggesting CLI do a one-time auto-migrate on startup with a prompt and opt-out: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/issues/412

jessica: please add a short note in the quickstart about `redwoodctl login --profile` vs `REDWOOD_PROFILE` env — onboarding keeps tripping people who expect `--profile` to persist across shells.

alex m: will add docs + a troubleshooting bullet for brew installs on mac arm vs intel (saves future debugging time). closing once PR merges.

marco: small DX suggestion — when config file is unreadable due to perms, CLI error should include a suggested `chown` command. would have saved 15min.
